name: frontend_shared
description: Dev-only test harness for the shared portal components/runtime. NOT a portal: the six *_portal builds import these source files via the @shared alias and emit no bundle from here. Its test deps (vitest, jsdom, @vue/test-utils) are declared once in the workspace root frontend/package.json, like every other frontend dep. Run `npm ci` at frontend/, then `npm test -w frontend_shared`.

scripts.test: vitest run && node --test driver-storage.security.test.mjs driver-tickets-pagination.security.test.mjs sw.security.test.mjs && node sw.generate.js --check
